cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you go, could you check this window latch?

mechanism: A makes permission to depart depend on resolving one more small household question, using each answer to extend the approval process.
confusable: D02 broadly invents reasons to stay; D26 specifically discovers another small task or question at each near-departure moment.
comparison: A new-home safety check turns explanations into further questions; the taxi scene turns completion and driver contact into another courtesy task.
seedUse: Use D26-a latch, moving curtain and fan switch, with S01 conditional release as the delaying style.
